formal_claims: Actual AIR satisfaction forces the new-word formula used by NearSpecV3.SHA512.nextWindow.
Every bounded w0,w1,w9,w14 input has an executable satisfying witness and exact input decoding.
Families of bounded inputs produce isolated schedule-core AIR traces at legal heights.
limitations: Only four source words are encoded by this arithmetic core; the other twelve window words are not stored here.
The 64 expansion test supplies window links in software, not in polynomial constraints.
Temporal window links and binding schedule words to compression rounds remain.
Round constants, block boundaries, feed-forward, padding and digest binding remain.
No full NEAR state transition, 1 Pgas capacity, sub-300 KB proof or 128-bit quantum-security claim.
